args.title: Saltmarsh Foods — Warehouse Automation in 2026 (Newsletter Summary)
args.body:
- Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter ("Warehouse automation in 2026") links to a blog article reporting that pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts.
- The article cautions that integration took twice as long as planned.
- The companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/warehouse/companion) adds that the biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks.
